description:
Unihertz is dedicated to developing unique smartphones for niche groups of people. We offer an array of innovative products including the smallest smartphones, QWERTY phones, rugged phones, dual-screen phones, etc., and successfully launched several popular products among smartphone enthusiasts on Kickstarter. As a well-established brand with over 6 years of smartphone R&D experience, we have successfully launched 10 Kickstarter campaigns. Additionally, our official online store attracts an average of 500K visitors per month.


Fast Facts:

  • 30-day cookie
  • 60-day validation window
  • $250 AOV


Products Available for Affiliate Promotion:

  • Jelly Series: The smallest smartphone
  • Titan Series: QWERTY PKB smartphones
  • TickTock Series: Unique dual-screen smartphones
  • Atom Series: Compact rugged smartphone (XL version with built-in walkie-talkie).
  • Tank Series: The 22,000mAh largest battery rugged smartphone
  • Luna Phone: Transparent back designed light-emitting phone


With an impressive AOV of $250, we offer a competitive commission rate of up to 10%, and we are committed to providing dedicated support by assigning a staff member specifically to assist you in setting up promotional campaigns.


If you are interested in promoting Unihertz unique phone products, please feel free to join our affiliate program to share a favorable commission >> Unihertz Affiliate Program


We look forward to the possibility of working together!
